subject: maths
question: A car covers a distance of 1032 km in 8 hours. The speed of a train is double the speed of the car. One-third the speed of the train is equal to the speed of a bike. How much distance will the bike cover in 17 hours?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance covered by car in 8 hours = 1032 km

Speed of train = 2 × Speed of car

One-third speed of train = Speed of bike

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Speed of car = dfrac{1032}{8} = 129 km/h

Speed of train = 2 × Speed of car

⇒ Speed of train = 2 × 129 = 258 km/h

Speed of bike = dfrac{1}{3} × Speed of train

⇒ Speed of bike = dfrac{1}{3} × 258 = 86 km/h

Distance covered by bike in 17 hours = Speed of bike × Time

⇒ Distance = 86 × 17 = 1462 km

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
